categories.title: Chest (Advanced)
categories.info:
Advanced Chests are sparkling pink-and-white boxes found throughout Miraland. In addition to normal chest rewards, they sometimes contain rare items like Outfit Sketches and Fragrances.

**Rewards:**
- Diamond x 30
- Bling x 1,000
- Mira EXP x 40
- Thread of Purity x 20

categories.info: Exclusive Quests are the longest kind of side quests, often involving a lengthy quest chain. Story quests tied to new updates will use Exclusive Quests in lieu of Main Quests.

categories.title: Inkrealm Scroll

locations.description: **Location:** Inside the [Danqing Trails](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-realm?locationIds=477673), specifically the scroll with the Koi fish. Enter the Danqing Trail and head right: when you get to the waterfall painting area, this Redable will be at the far end of the structure!

locations.title: Untying the Knot
locations.description:
**Previous:** [Whispers of History in the Painting](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-realm?locationIds=474962)

- Resonite Crystal x1

- Blings x20K
- [Old Illusions](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-realm?locationIds=507800) (sketch)

**Next:** [New Blossoms on Old Branches](https://mapgenie.io/infinity-nikki/maps/danqing-island?locationIds=476978)
